text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Now, onward to Tokyo Racecourse!
Did you bring your lunchbox?
Do carrots count as a snack?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Let's make sure to fully enjoy spectating
the Japan Derby today!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Right away, Bakushin O-san!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Still, Trainer, so you're passing on the Derby after all. I totally expected you to tell me to enter...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Um... why did you pass on it?
choice_data_list: ...I had a bad feeling about it.

text_block_list.text: If Kitasan Black was up for it, I certainly considered entering the race. However...

A GⅠ over the uncharted distance of 2,400 meters.
And on the Tokyo course, with its long homestretch that demands a razor-sharp burst of speed...

I couldn't picture a good outcome at all.
If suffering a crushing defeat would only shatter my confidence further,
it's better to sit this one out.

And the race unfolded—
just as expected.
(UOOOOOOOOOOH!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
What is this pace!? It's an unprecedented,
blistering pace! The front-runners are collapsing!
Breaking through the pack is—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
It's Brusqueman! Brusqueman crosses the finish line now!
There's no one to challenge her!
It's a Derby record! A new Derby record!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Oooooh...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
A Derby record... Amazing...
If I were to run
in a race like this...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't do a single thing...
At such an absurdly fast pace, trying to hang on with sheer guts was just impossible...

Whether by coincidence or inevitability,
the race unfolded in such a harsh, one-sided manner that Kitasan Black was left utterly speechless.

Returning to the trainer's office,
I decided to review today's events.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...
2400m... Middle and long distances are truly terrifying.
Once you run out of steam, you just keep sinking...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Can I really handle GⅠ races at 2400m or longer like today's?
I'm not feeling super confident...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: "No, no, Kitasan Black-san, there is no need to worry!"

Sakura Bakushin O, who had been listening in,
confidently interjected into the conversation.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black-san is well-suited for both medium and long distances.
There's no doubt about it, so please don't worry!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Bakushin O-san,
how did you know?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu~, goes without saying!
Just who do you think your special coach is?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"I am Sakura Bakushin O! An Umamusume who has
conquered the long distance of 1200m × 3 multiple times!"
"As far as I know, Sakura Bakushin O is a sprint expert. She has delivered great performances in numerous sprint GⅠs until now."

Still, I've never heard of an interpretation
where 1200m × 3 = 3600m = long distance.
Sounds like bizarre cosmic nonsense to me, but...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
If Bakushin O says so,
I feel like everything will be all right, Trainer!
choice_data_list: No, it's just my imagination, surely...

text_block_list.text:
I lightly stop Kitasan Black,
who was about to fall for it, and think.

Distance aptitude is a rather tricky factor.
The only way to truly gauge it is through the accumulation
of actual race experience.
As a Trainer, I thought she could handle long distances based on her running form... but at this stage, I couldn't say for certain.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, if it turns out I'm not suited
for longer distances...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
3,000m... The Kikuka Sho in the autumn
might be even tougher.
I have to fire myself up and train hard!
